feature1.prompt: Add --skip-checks option to management commands. Management commands already have a hidden skip_checks option. Expose this option on the command line so that users can choose to skip system checks when running a command. In many development environments, being able to bypass these checks helps users focus on the task at hand rather than being delayed by system validations.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature involves enhancing the command line interface for management commands. Update the DjangoHelpFormatter to include '--skip-checks' in its set of visible options. Modify the BaseCommand.create_parser() method so that if a command requires system checks, the '--skip-checks' argument is added. Also, update the BaseCommand.execute() method to bypass the system check when the '--skip-checks' option is provided.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/core/management/base.py. In particular, adjust the DjangoHelpFormatter (update the show_last set), modify BaseCommand.create_parser() (to add the '--skip-checks' argument when appropriate) and change BaseCommand.execute() to use options['skip_checks'] for bypassing system checks.

feature2.prompt: Add --skip-checks option to management commands. Management commands already have a hidden skip_checks option that is not available to users. By exposing this option on the command line, users can skip system checks when executing a command. This is especially useful in scenarios where bypassing system validations allows for smoother, uninterrupted development workflows.
feature2.hint_texts: This feature focuses on testing and validation of the new '--skip-checks' option. Implement a new test case that sets up an appropriate settings environment and invokes a management command using the '--skip-checks' flag. The test should verify that system checks are bypassed and the expected output is returned. Make sure that this new test does not interfere with the existing suite of tests.
feature2.entrypoint: File: tests/user_commands/tests.py. Add a new test method (for example, test_skip_checks) that writes a settings file, runs a command with the '--skip-checks' flag, and asserts that the command output is as expected without triggering system checks.

+            'STATICFILES_DIRS': '"foo"',
+        })
+        out, err = self.run_manage(['set_option', '--skip-checks', '--set', 'foo'])
+        self.assertNoOutput(err)
